'''Kallig's Countenance''' was the mask of the ancient [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Aloysius Kallig]]. It was found and claimed by the Sith Lord [[Khreusis]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and recovered by [[Darth Nox]], Aloysius Kallig's descendant, after killing Khreusis.
